newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor expects rise in EPS from 97.
newsitem.headline: Accor expects rise in EPS from 97.

text.p: Hotel group Accor said on Wednesday that the merger of Sphere International, which groups the budget hotels, into Accor would lead to a two franc earnings per share increase from 1997.
"The merger of Sphere International into Accor was approved at an extraordinary session" after the annual shareholders' meeting, it said in a statement.

"With a parity of seven Sphere International shares for one Accor share, 2,347,761 new Accor shares were created. This operation allows Accor to take full control of the budget hotel segment, which is experiencing growth, and will lead to an improvement of two francs in Accor's earnings per share from 1997," it said.
